For a change, Sky-Scraper (that's a joke, you see), EWAZ, Scholar of the Infinite and Eternal Haka fought advanced Progeny in the Final Wasteland. Giant Sky-Scraper is so good to have incapacitated against Progeny, but she wasn't enough to help the Scholar hold out in the end.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
More cardboard! I played a game of "Can I play the Argent Adept without computer assistance?" plus "I've only played Naturalist and KNYFE once" plus "let's see how Akash-Bhuta deals with a targetless environment!" Unfortunately, it turns out she deals just fine, while Freedom Tower kinda sucks for Naturalist and even KNYFE. Things were going pretty well until a late-game rush to take out Akash herself left a bunch of Rockslides with +3 damage in play, taking the heroes down for the count. Oops. I at least came away with a much better view on KNYFE than my first game with her!
 
With room for another game, it was time for (most of) the Prime Wardens to go vampire hunting! In a single turn, Argent Adept, Haka, Tempest and Fanatic learned why it wasn't a good idea to face Apostate in the Court of Blood; two rounds later, they taught him why the Prime Wardens are not to be trifled with. These guys rock. :D And yes, since you asked, I can play Argent Adept without assistance, thank you very much. :V
